author: Matt Wolfe
description:
What if your credit card could remember everything for you?

SecondBrain Note is a credit-card-thin AI recorder that captures your meetings, conversations, and ideas, then turns them into organized notes and actionable follow-ups.

It can even connect to tools like your email, calendar, Slack, Notion, and Google Workspace, so its Super Agent can draft emails, find old ideas, and pull together action items for you.
